description: Virtual servers in the cloud that provide scalable computing capacity. You can launch instances with different configurations of CPU, memory, storage, and networking to match your workload requirements.
usecase: Host a web application backend on a t3.medium instance with auto-scaling to handle traffic spikes during peak hours.
additionalInfo: Pay only for what you use with per-second billing
Choose from multiple instance types optimized for different use cases
Launch instances in multiple availability zones for high availability
Use Elastic IPs for static IP addresses

description: Serverless compute service that runs code in response to events without provisioning or managing servers. Pay only for compute time consumed.
usecase: Automatically generate thumbnails whenever a user uploads an image to S3, with the function scaling automatically based on upload frequency.
additionalInfo: Supports multiple programming languages (Node.js, Python, Java, Go, etc.)
Automatic scaling from zero to thousands of concurrent executions
Integrated with AWS services via event triggers
First 1 million requests per month are free

description: Object storage service offering industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance. Store and retrieve any amount of data at any time from anywhere on the web.
usecase: Store user-uploaded images for a social media application with automatic image optimization using Lambda triggers.
additionalInfo: Durability of 99.999999999% (11 nines)
Multiple storage classes for cost optimization
Versioning and lifecycle policies supported
Built-in encryption and access control

description: Managed relational database service supporting multiple engines (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MariaDB). AWS handles backup, patching, and hardware provisioning.
usecase: Run a PostgreSQL database for an e-commerce platform with automated daily backups and Multi-AZ deployment for high availability.
additionalInfo: Automated backups with point-in-time recovery
Multi-AZ deployments for disaster recovery
Read replicas for improved read performance
Supports encryption at rest and in transit

description: Isolated virtual network within AWS cloud where you can launch resources in a defined virtual network. Complete control over network configuration including IP address ranges, subnets, and routing tables.
usecase: Create a secure network with public subnets for web servers accessible from the internet, and private subnets for databases accessible only from the application tier.
additionalInfo: Create up to 5 VPCs per region by default
Use security groups and NACLs for network security
Connect to on-premises networks via VPN or Direct Connect
Enable VPC Flow Logs for network traffic monitoring

description: Service for securely controlling access to AWS resources. Create and manage users, groups, roles, and policies to specify who can access which resources.
usecase: Create a developer role with permissions to deploy to S3 and Lambda, while restricting access to production databases.
additionalInfo: Free service with no additional charges
Supports multi-factor authentication (MFA)
Integrate with corporate directories via SAML 2.0
Fine-grained permissions using IAM policies
